reviews.title: Elegant backside connector motherboard
reviews.comment:
Why did you pick this product vs others?:
I chose it to pair with an all-white panoramic view chassis
. Its PCB and even the BIOS interface are white, showcasing a strong sense of design consistency. The silver-white armor that covers the entire motherboard is also perfect for creating a modern minimalist style—I love everything about it.
As for performance, there’s not much to say—it’s absolutely top-tier. MSI’s BIOS is stable and reliable, and the Wi-Fi module uses Intel solution rather than a cheaper MTK option. I’m currently running DDR5-8000 memory fully stable, and I’m very satisfied.
